name: The Alps
description: High snow, cloud seas below the ridgeline and lakes the colour of sea glass.
coverAlt: Jagged snow peaks rising above a sea of cloud at sunrise, the sky fading from pink to blue

name: Japan
description: Wooden lanes at dusk, red pagodas, and one mountain that keeps showing up.
coverAlt: A red five-storey pagoda in a green hillside with Mount Fuji rising over the town beyond

name: India
description: Marble at dawn, yellow taxis at night, and streets that never quite empty.
coverAlt: The Taj Mahal at dawn, mirrored in a long reflecting pool lined with clipped cypresses

name: Indonesia
description: Temples in mist, on lakes and on hilltops, from Bali to Java.
coverAlt: Bell-shaped stupas rising through morning haze at Borobudur

name: Paris
description: The river at dusk, gilded lamps coming on, and a skyline you already know.
coverAlt: The Eiffel Tower against a lilac dusk sky with the river in the foreground

name: The Scottish Highlands
description: On the list: green ridges, low cloud and a band of gold on the horizon.
coverAlt: Green highland ridges under low cloud with a band of golden light on the horizon
